rows.label: MiCA
rows.text: Fully applicable since 30 Dec 2024. The transition for crypto service providers ended on 1 Jul 2026: providers serving the EU need a MiCA licence.
rows.text_sk: Platí v plnom rozsahu od 30. 12. 2024. Prechodné obdobie pre poskytovateľov kryptoslužieb skončilo 1. 7. 2026: kto slúži klientom v EÚ, potrebuje licenciu MiCA.

rows.label: Tax SK · CZ
rows.text: SK: 19–35% income tax + 16% health contributions, no holding exemption. CZ: tax-free after 3 years of holding.
rows.text_sk: SK: 19–35 % daň z príjmu + 16 % zdravotné odvody, bez oslobodenia po držbe. CZ: po 3 rokoch držby bez dane.
rows.source: Virtuse Tax Agent (Q3 2026). Not tax advice.
